## Markdown

| Element | Syntax |
|---|---|
| Heading | `## Heading`, `### Subheading` |
| Bold / italic / strikethrough | `**bold**` / `*italic*` / `~~strike~~` |
| Bulleted / numbered list | `- item` / `1. item` |
| Task list | `- [ ] task` / `- [x] done` |
| Link | `[text](https://...)` or `[text](page.qmd)` |
| Email link | `[me@example.gov](mailto:me@example.gov)` |
| Inline code | `` `code` `` |
| Quote | `> quote` |
| Horizontal line | `---` with a blank line above |
| Comment | `<!-- note -->` |

Tables:

```markdown
| County | Cases |
|:-------|------:|
| Clark  |   120 |
```

## Quarto extras

````markdown
::: {.callout-tip}
A tip. Also: callout-note, callout-warning, callout-important, callout-caution
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
Hidden until clicked.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}
## Tab one
Content
## Tab two
Content
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
Left
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
Right
:::
::::

![Caption](image.png){#fig-name fig-alt="What the image shows."}
See @fig-name.

A footnote.^[The note text.]
````

## Code

````markdown
```{r}
#| label: fig-cases
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Visible caption"
#| fig-alt: "Chart type, variables, and main pattern."
plot(cases)
```

Inline: there were `{r} nrow(cases)` cases.
````

| Chunk option | Effect |
|---|---|
| `echo: false` | Hide code, show result |
| `eval: false` | Show code, don't run it |
| `include: false` | Run, show nothing |
| `warning: false` / `message: false` | Hide warnings / messages |
| `fig-alt` | Alt text (required for every chart) |
| `fig-cap` | Visible caption |

## HTML report header

```yaml
---
title: "Report title"
author: "Your Name"
date: today
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    embed-resources: true     # one self-contained file
    code-fold: true           # code behind "Code" buttons
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---
```

## Slides (revealjs)

```yaml
---
title: "Talk title"
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-number: true
    incremental: false
    footer: "Footer text"
    embed-resources: true
---
```

| In the file | Does |
|---|---|
| `## Title` | New slide |
| `---` | New slide without a title |
| `# Section` | Section title slide |
| `::: {.incremental}` … `:::` | List appears item by item |
| `. . .` | Pause |
| `::: {.notes}` … `:::` | Speaker notes |

| While presenting | Key |
|---|---|
| Full screen | **F** |
| Speaker view | **S** |
| Overview | **Esc** / **O** |
| Save as PDF | add `?print-pdf` to the URL, then print |

## Websites

```yaml
project:
  type: website
  output-dir: docs
  resources:
    - "/.nojekyll"

website:
  title: "My Site"
  search: true
  page-navigation: true
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - href: lessons/01-intro.qmd
        text: Lessons
  sidebar:
    style: docked
    contents:
      - section: "Lessons"
        contents: "lessons/*"
  page-footer:
    center: "Questions? [me@example.gov](mailto:me@example.gov)"

format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
      dark: darkly
    respect-user-color-scheme: true
    toc: true
```

## Commands and shortcuts

| Task | Terminal | Positron / VS Code | RStudio |
|---|---|---|---|
| Check setup | `quarto check` | | |
| New website | `quarto create project website my-site` | **Quarto: Create Project** | **File → New Project → Quarto Website** |
| Preview | `quarto preview` | **Ctrl + Shift + K** | **Render** button |
| Render one file | `quarto render file.qmd` | | **Render** button |
| Render a whole site | `quarto render` | `quarto render` in the terminal | **Build → Render Website** |
| Visual editor | | **Ctrl + Shift + F4** | **Visual** button |

## Publish to GitHub Pages

1. `output-dir: docs` and an empty `.nojekyll` file
2. `quarto render`
3. Commit everything, **including `docs/`**, and push
4. **Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → `main` → `/docs` → Save**

**Every update:** edit → `quarto render` → commit (with `docs/`) → push.

## Before you share or publish

- [ ] No real or unreleased data, credentials, or internal details
- [ ] Every image and chart has alt text
- [ ] Headings in order; link text is meaningful
- [ ] Previewed in light and dark mode; links work
